title: Sober and Building
style: honest indie electronic, 100 BPM, sobriety and clarity theme, male vocal direct and grounded, personal achievement without sentimentality, working through the night energy, 2026 momentum, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
Sober since Ruby's birthday
September 25 — marked the day
Not a ceremony — a decision
That's how things change their way
Hustling since January first
No sleep — two to six hours
Electrolytes and fasting
That's how you build the towers

[CHORUS]
Sober and building
That's the combination
Sober and building
The clearest foundation
Standing to type — working through the night
Sober and building — doing it right
No noise — just signal
Sober and building — final

[VERSE 2]
The money from Michelle's card
The Anthropic key rotated
The crypto wallets found on VPS
Nothing wasted — nothing dated
336 tracks toward the target
ZYNVAULT indexed and running
Sober and building — every session
Sober and building — incoming

[BRIDGE — direct and personal]
This isn't a recovery story.
This is a building story.
The sobriety was the scaffolding.
The building is the point.

[OUTRO]
Sober. Building. Still here. Still going.
